- Other Email Addresses Used: [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email]
- Country: United Kingdom

WHAT I AM REQUESTING:
Please confirm whether you are processing personal data concerning me and, if so, provide a copy of that data together with all of the information required by Article 15(1):

1. A copy of all personal data you hold about me, in a commonly used electronic format (Article 15(3)).
2. The purposes of the processing (Article 15(1)(a)).
3. The categories of personal data concerned (Article 15(1)(b)).
4. The recipients or categories of recipient to whom my data has been or will be disclosed, including any recipients in third countries or international organisations, and the safeguards relied upon for any such transfer (Article 15(1)(c) and Article 15(2)). Please name the specific organisations rather than describing them generically.
5. The envisaged retention period, or the criteria used to determine it (Article 15(1)(d)).

TIMEFRAME:

This is to confirm that the data provided has been processed.

Thank you for your inquiry about your personal information. We value your privacy and appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns.

Please note that when we receive a request to "opt out," "delete," or "do not sell" a consumer's personal information, we interpret these requests as "do not sell requests," because that permits us to maintain a consumer's information in a "suppression file," which allows us to prevent that information from being added to databases used for marketing at a later time. If this is not what you intended for us to do, please let us know at privacy@firstdirectmarketing.com. This will be effective within 15 business days of the receipt of your request.

We sometimes work with online advertising platforms who create online advertising data. To opt out of cookie-based advertising models, you can visit the opt-out pages operated by two industry organizations, the DAA and the NAI. The DAA opt-out page is at https://youradchoices.com/ and the NAI opt-out page is at https://optout.networkadvertising.org/. We do not operate these sites - we advise you of this simply for your information.

Here is the information regarding how we handle personal data at First Direct:

- Categories of Personal Information Collected
We utilize data that is self-reported and sourced from external data compilers, with no compilation conducted by us directly.

- Specific Pieces of Personal Information Collected
The data typically includes Address, Name, Phone, and other self-reported elements such as Age and Gender.

- Categories of Sources from Which the Business Collected Personal Information
Our data is sourced exclusively from external data compilers.

- Purposes for Which the Business Uses the Personal Information
We use this information to facilitate legal and ethical marketing campaigns.

- Categories of Third Parties with Whom the Business Shares the Personal Information
Our clients include but are not limited to a variety of businesses such as Mattress Stores, Flooring Stores, Banks, and Home Improvement companies.

- Categories of Information That the Business Sells or Discloses to Third Parties
We primarily disclose name and address information for third-party mailing and analytical purposes.

In line with your request to cease the use of your personal information, we are placing your details on our internal suppression file to prevent future distribution. Please note, however, that since First Direct is not the originator of the compiled databases, we are unable to directly remove your data from all existing records. We will endeavor to ensure your information is not shared going forward, based on the data under our control.

If there are any more details you would like to discuss, or additional questions you may have, please do not hesitate to contact us.

If you have any questions or require additional support, please do not hesitate to contact our customer service team at 402-403-0004 or via email at privacy@firstdirectmarketing.com.

Thank you for your understanding and for trusting us with your concerns.


~ Audrey
First Direct

Because we do not process or store the information our businesses customers might collect through their use of our software, we ask you to please refer to the privacy policy of the customer who is using our Services with you to learn about their collection and use of your information.   Scraping Robot respects the privacy of users of our website and related services. Greetings,

Komodo Health, Inc. has received your request and is providing the
following response.

As a US-headquartered business-to-business (“B2B”) company, our processing
of UK personal data is strictly limited to specific contexts. To determine
if we are the Controller of any data related to this individual and to
ensure a proportionate search of our systems (pursuant to Section 78
of the Data
Use and Access Act 2025), we require further information.

Please be advised that we will only process this request if the individual
falls into one of the following two categories. You must provide the
required details within 30 calendar days:

1. Current or Former Employees of our UK Entity If the individual  that is
the subject of the request is/was employed by our UK legal entity, please
specify:

   -

   The exact name of the Komodo Health legal entity that employed them.
   -

   The approximate dates of employment.

2. Authorized Users of Komodo Health Products If the individual is a
natural person with a user account provided via one of our corporate B2B
contracts, please specify:

   -

   The specific Komodo Health product(s) they are authorized to use.
   -

   The specific business email address used to log into the product.

Notice of "Stopped Clock" and Closure: Under the Data Use and Access Act
2025, the statutory one-month period for responding to a request is paused
while the controller awaits information necessary to identify the data or
the requester.

If we do not receive the specific information requested above within 30
calendar days of this email, we will conclude that the individual does not
have a relationship with our firm and that the request is manifestly
unfounded. In that event, we will consider this matter closed and will take
no further action.

Best regards,

Office of the Chief Privacy Officer

Thank you for contacting the US Marketing Group Privacy Office. We have received your request under applicable state privacy laws, including for example the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and have conducted a search of our records using the information you provided.

If your request included a right to delete, it has been automatically processed - if a record matching your information existed in our system, it has been addressed.

Please do not send us more information than what is needed to verify your identity. Upon receipt of this information, we will promptly evaluate your request and respond within the timeframe required.

Once we have verified your identity, we will review applicable databases using the information you provided. If no personal information is located, we will promptly inform you of that outcome.

Privacy Office

3639 Harbor Blvd. Suite 212
Ventura, CA 93001

 Hunter is a B2B email finder service. Our database contains professional email addresses associated with company domains. We do not collect, store, or index personal email addresses from consumer providers (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook/Hotmail, iCloud, GMX, web.de, and similar).

 The Hunter Privacy Team

Dear Requester,

Thank you for contacting Spokeo Customer Care.

Spokeo collects publicly available information about US residents from a variety of public sources, including phone books, social networks, marketing surveys, real estate listings, business websites, and other public sources (collectively “Public Information”). The listings on Spokeo.com contain only Public Information. Our people search services are intended to provide contact information only for people living in the United States.

When a Spokeo profile contains information about an EU data subject, it is typically Public Information that you provided to a social network and that is or was made public. Spokeo does not process personal data for or at the request of any social network, as Spokeo and its data providers obtain the information from publicly available profiles that you have authorized, or did authorize, the social network to make public. As such, in this context, Spokeo is neither a controller nor a processor of your personal data under GDPR.

Spokeo regards your inquiry as a request to have your Public Information removed from the public listings available on Spokeo.com. As such, Spokeo has suppressed from public display on Spokeo.com the Public Information it believes to be associated with you (based on the information you provided about yourself in your inquiry). Please allow 24-72 hours to see this reflect on our site.

Spokeo’s database contains billions of public records, and Spokeo is constantly receiving new or updated records. When Spokeo receives new or updated records, Spokeo will endeavor to link those new or updated records to your privacy preference. However, should you in the future find another listing containing Public Information about you on Spokeo.com, the fastest and simplest way to make your request is via our easy, self-service tool located at www.spokeo.com/optout. This tool is available to anyone (regardless of place of residency), and the only information you will be required to submit is the link to the Spokeo profile containing your information and an email address to which we will send an email requiring you to confirm your request.

If your request actually pertains to personal data such as information that users provide to Spokeo about themselves or information about their use of Spokeo (which is not included in the Public Information that is made available through the Spokeo.com people search), you may utilize our easy to use, self-service tool which you’ll find here: https://www.spokeo.com/privacy/control/account/results. This page will ask you to enter your Spokeo login information to begin the process of accessing your account information. You can also contact us via phone at 1-877-864-0183 during regular business hours.

Please note that the correspondence related to this matter will only be used for purposes of handling this matter.

Spokeo reserves all rights.

Sincerely,

Meagan

Thanks for reaching out. The information in our reports comes entirely from public and
private databases — things like court records, property records, and phone listings —
and can include names, addresses, and phone numbers.

Before we share any specific details, we need to be sure we're sharing them with the
right person. Because our information comes from public sources, a name or address
alone isn't enough to confirm identity. Please reply with:

• Date of birth
• Current and previous addresses
• Phone numbers
• This statement, with today's date: "I declare under penalty of perjury that I am [full
name] and that the information above is true and correct."

Once we have this, we'll check our records and respond as soon as we can. If we can't
match your details to one specific person, we won't be able to share them — we'd rather
decline than risk sharing someone else's information.

From: [REDACTED:email] <[REDACTED:email]>

Subject: Subject Access Request - Article 15 UK GDPR

To the Data Protection Officer at Next Wave Marketing Strategies, Inc,

I am writing to make a subject access request under Article 15 of the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. I am a UK resident.

PERSONAL IDENTIFICATION:
- Full Name: [REDACTED:name]
- Email Address: [REDACTED:email]
- Other Email Addresses Used: [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email], [REDACTED:email]
- Country: United Kingdom

WHAT I AM REQUESTING:
Please confirm whether you are processing personal data concerning me and, if so, provide a copy of that data together with all of the information required by Article 15(1):

1. A copy of all personal data you hold about me, in a commonly used electronic format (Article 15(3)).
2. The purposes of the processing (Article 15(1)(a)).
3. The categories of personal data concerned (Article 15(1)(b)).
4. The recipients or categories of recipient to whom my data has been or will be disclosed, including any recipients in third countries or international organisations, and the safeguards relied upon for any such transfer (Article 15(1)(c) and Article 15(2)). Please name the specific organisations rather than describing them generically.
5. The envisaged retention period, or the criteria used to determine it (Article 15(1)(d)).
6. The source from which my personal data was obtained, since it was not collected from me directly (Article 15(1)(g)). Please identify the specific source, not merely "publicly available records" or "third party partners".
7. The existence of any automated decision-making, including profiling, together with meaningful information about the logic involved and the significance and envisaged consequences of such processing for me (Article 15(1)(h) and Article 22).
8. Any inferences, scores, segments, classifications or derived attributes you have generated about me. These are personal data and fall within the scope of this request.

If you hold data about me under any name variant, former address, or email address listed above, please include it. If you operate multiple brands, databases or products, please treat this request as covering all of them.

TIMEFRAME:
Under Article 12(3) of the UK GDPR you must respond without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of this request. If you consider the request complex or numerous and intend to rely on the two-month extension, you must inform me of that, and of the reasons for the delay, within one month of receipt.

This request is made free of charge. A fee may only be charged where a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive, and I would ask you to explain your reasoning in writing should you seek to rely on that.

IDENTITY VERIFICATION:
If you require further information to verify my identity, please tell me specifically what you need and why it is necessary. Please note that under Article 12(6) you may only request information necessary to confirm my identity. I will not supply identity documents beyond what is proportionate to that purpose, and I would ask that you do not require me to create an account or supply data you do not already hold in order to exercise this right.

If you do not hold any personal data about me, please confirm that explicitly in writing.

If I do not receive an adequate response within the statutory period, I intend to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office under Article 77 of the UK GDPR.

Please send your response to [REDACTED:email].

Yours faithfully,
[REDACTED:name]
August 30, 2026

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.1.10

This error occurs because the sender sent a message to an email address hosted by Office 365 but the address is incorrect or doesn't exist at the destination domain. The error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it must be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

The email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - If you have a hybrid environment and are using directory synchronization make sure the recipient's email address is synced correctly in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Errant forwarding rule - Check for forwarding rules that aren't behaving as expected. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Inbox Rules feature.

Recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license (Users > Active Users > select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Mail flow settings and MX records are not correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are configured correctly.

For more information and additional tips to fix this issue, see Fix email delivery issues for error code 5.1.10 in Office 365<https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=532972>.
